item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00191","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C19","C10","C07"],"selected_candidate_label":"C19","confidence":0.73,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C19 plausibly supplied a material template because it is an earlier presidential message to a major labor organization that extends good wishes, praises organized labor as essential to national strength and freedom, addresses union leaders and members collectively, and uses the distinctive image of a national “bulwark.” The child compresses that same rhetorical structure into a dedication telegram. C10 has a similar short-message structure and links an organization’s cooperative activity to the strength of the economic system, but it is less specifically aligned with trade unionism. C07 offers only generic conference greetings and national-values language.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Strong, dedicated, democratic trade unionism is one of the bulwarks of our American way of life.","parent_excerpt":"The productive might of America is the greatest bulwark of world peace... Your future and the future of your unions, in common with all free American institutions, will be determined by our ability further to strengthen our country","explanation":"Both cast organized labor as a bulwark supporting national freedom and strength, with the child adapting and condensing the parent’s imagery."},{"child_excerpt":"To the International Brotherhood of Teamsters, its officers and members, I extend my best wishes","parent_excerpt":"To the Fifteenth Constitutional Convention of the Congress of Industrial Organizations, I extend greetings and good wishes.","explanation":"The messages share a direct ceremonial address to a labor organization followed by an explicit extension of presidential wishes."},{"child_excerpt":"Our democracy and our economy both make possible and draw strength from free trade unions.","parent_excerpt":"the aspirations and needs of working men and women are fully and forcefully represented at the highest level of government... promote sound and peaceful industrial relationships so essential to the economic well-being of American working men and women and to the welfare of all elements of our nation","explanation":"Both connect free organized labor with democratic representation, economic well-being, and broader national welfare."}]}
